steps.question: Lesson 8: AK vs Two All-Ins. What is your best action?

gradingSpecJson.responseIncorrect: There is a better line in this node.
gradingSpecJson.followUpContent: AK vs two all-ins. Often a coin flip or behind an overpair; with two opponents you're frequently dominated. Folding 35k is +EV here. Core lesson: AK is strong heads-up but multi-way all-ins change everything—someone often has a pair, and you're drawing. Don't assume AK is always a call; when the price and number of opponents make you an underdog, folding is correct. Read the situation, not just the hand.
